content.short: Blast is a decentralized API platform with multichain support.
content.description: Blast is a high-performance blockchain API platform delivering fast, reliable access to decentralized networks. It provides scalable RPC, WebSocket, and archive node infrastructure designed for developers building and scaling web3 applications. With support for major chains including Ethereum, BNB Chain, Fantom, Polygon, Solana, Starknet, and more, Blast helps teams reduce latency and maximize uptime, enabling production-grade apps with confidence.
